2608.11408.title: Measure, Don't Optimize: Forecasting Recovery in LLM Unlearning
2608.11408.paper_summary: Prior white-box studies show that large language models can retain latent traces of target knowledge after unlearning, even when the knowledge is no longer expressed in their outputs. However, existing audits remain limited to one-off diagnostics: it is unclear whether these residual signals can predict future recovery under continued training or serve as reliable optimization targets. Resolving this gap is essential to determine whether internal auditing can move beyond post-hoc evaluation toward proactive risk monitoring and safer unlearning. We propose J-Access, an inference-time audit that uses the Jacobian lens to map intermediate representations into vocabulary space and measures how often target concepts remain accessible along the model's output pathway. We hypothesize that residual accessibility reflects recovery susceptibility: knowledge that remains closer to the output pathway requires less fine-tuning to restore, leading to faster recovery. We audit 398 public unlearned models spanning eight unlearning methods. We find that: (1) most unlearned models retain access above the retain-only gold level; (2) pre-attack accessibility predicts recovery speed and extent at the model level, but cannot identify which specific facts will be recovered; and (3) directly minimizing J-Access does not promote genuine deletion. Instead, the model learns to hide knowledge from the audit, producing lower audit scores but greater post-attack recovery. These findings position J-Access as a model-level diagnostic for assessing residual susceptibility in unlearned models. We argue internal audits should serve as an independent diagnostic dimension in unlearning evaluation, and should not be converted into optimization targets without validation.
2608.11408.paper_summary_zh: 先前的白盒研究顯示，大型語言模型在去學習後仍能保留目標知識的潛在痕跡，即使這些知識不再在其輸出中表達。然而，現有的審計仍然限於一次性的診斷：尚不清楚這些殘餘信號是否能預測在持續訓練下的未來恢復，或作為可靠的優化目標。解決這一差距對於確定內部審計是否能超越事後評估，朝向主動風險監控和更安全的去學習至關重要。我們提出了 J-Access，一種推理時的審計，使用雅可比視角將中間表示映射到詞彙空間，並測量目標概念在模型輸出路徑上保持可訪問的頻率。我們假設殘餘可訪問性反映了恢復的易感性：保持更接近輸出路徑的知識需要較少的微調來恢復，從而導致更快的恢復。我們審計了398個公共的未學習模型，涵蓋八種去學習方法。我們發現：（1）大多數未學習模型的可訪問性高於僅保留金標準；（2）攻擊前的可訪問性預測了模型層面的恢復速度和範圍，但無法識別哪些特定事實將被恢復；（3）直接最小化 J-Access 不促進真正的刪除。相反，模型學會隱藏知識以避免審計，產生較低的審計分數但更大的攻擊後恢復。這些發現使 J-Access 成為評估未學習模型中殘餘易感性的模型層診斷。我們認為內部審計應作為去學習評估中的獨立診斷維度，且在未經驗證的情況下不應轉換為優化目標。
